race.name: Goblins
race.description: While Goblins live underground, they are often found raiding the countryside during the night. Goblins are a small wicked race, full of cleverness, deceit, and mechanical ingenuity. Goblins live in clans and tend to be very loyal to their clan. Both the males and females of this race have similar physical stature.

race.name: Orcs, Greater
race.description: Orcs, Greater

race.name: Gnolls
race.description: While Gnolls generally inhabit the upper highlands, they seldom seek homes far from the surface. They are not an unfriendly folk, but it does take time before they warm to strangers. Most Gnolls persue magical studies and arts, but every tribe has its warriors. It is curious to noet hthat both males and females have the same physical builds.

race.name: Men, Mixed
race.description: Mixed men have some High blood, but have interbred with common men.

race.name: Half-orcs
race.description: Half-orcs are the result of breeding men with orcs, usually by rape

race.name: Dwarves
race.description: Although Dwarves are spread across the world, they are close to one another and have spawned a universal reputation for ruggedness, practicality and unwavering loyalty. Most groups favour the rocky highlands and deep caverns of the mountains. They are superior craftsmen and they love to mine the earth for precious gems and metals to forge into weapons of strength and artifacts of beauty and power.

race.name: Halflings, Haerfeat
race.description: Halflings have an unclear origin, although they arose about the same time as Men. Indeed, they are said to be related to Men. The most common of the Halflings, the Haerfeat are the smallest in stature and most darkly complected. Their height rarely exceeds three feet and they have deeply tanned skin and dark hair colours; browns, auburns and blacks. Males tend to wear their hair short and do not cultivate any facial hair. Tidy and neat the Haerfeat are often thought of as the typical example of the Halfling race.

race.name: Halflings, Staeknil
race.description: Halflings have an unclear origin, although they arose about the same time as Men. Indeed, they are said to be related to Men. Stockiest of the Halfling folk, the Staeknil often appear shorter than their cousin Haerfeat due to a sturdier and somewhat wider profile. They are in fact the taller of the two strains, but not as tall as the Waenfal. their tastes and styles are also somewhat of a compromise, as are their physical features, being more subdued than the Waenfal in dress, but possessing the dark curly locks of their Haerfeat kin. A trait common only to males of Staeknil blood, however is the ability to sustain beard growth, which makes them somewhat more endearing to Dwarven-kind. Thus are the Staeknil on better terms with the Drawf peoples than others of their kind in matters of commerce and social interaction.

race.name: Halflings, Waerlin
race.description: Halflings have an unclear origin, although they arose about the same time as Men. Indeed, they are said to be related to Men. Rarest of teh Halflings are the Waerlin, who differ from their cousins in a number of ways. Standing an average three and a half feet in height, they are the second tallest strain of Halfling, falling short only to the Waenfal. They are oft suspected to have had soem Elvish blood intermingled in their ancestral line once upon a time, for their eyes are slightly canted and their ears have a gentle upsweeping to them, rising to a point. Likewise they are slimmer as a rule than other Halflings, but do share their cousins' tremendous appetites. Though lighter iin complexion than other strains, their hair colours range the broad spectrum of the Mannish races. Their eye colours, however, are extraordinary, exhibiting brightly jeweled hues of greens, blues, ambers, and violets. The Waerlin also favour waering boots as another contrast, and their feet tend to be more in proportion with the rest of their bodies. they keep close ties with the Elvish peoples, and their ideas and inclinations are also slightly broader than others of their kind, allowing more of an acceptance of things in the outside world.

race.name: Halflings, Waenfel
race.description: Halflings have an unclear origin, although they arose about the same time as Men. Indeed, they are said to be related to Men. Tallest of the folk, the Waenfal stand closer to 4 feet in height upon reaching adulthood. Fairer of skin and colouration, they of all the Halfling strains resemble the Mannish races the most. They have lighter hair colourations, with blondes, reds, and light browns being the norm. While they are fewer than their brethren, the Waenfal interact on a more basic level with Men-folk than do others of their kind, openly trading and exchanging items and ideas with the Mannish cultures of the outer world.

race.name: Hobgoblins
race.description: Hobgoblins are a soldier race, male and female alike. They are usually unforgiving in their conquering and will rarely forget a defeat (until they have their revenge). Fighting and war are the entire lifestyle for Hobgoblins.

race.name: Elves, Wood
race.description: Wood elves are slender preferring to live in woodland and have a rustic society compared to other elves.

race.name: Orcs, Grey
race.description: Orcs, Grey

race.name: Elves, Grey
race.description: Grey elves are stockier than woodland elves, though still more slender than humans and live in cities and large towns. They are the most likely to travel outside their own community.

race.name: Men, High
race.description: High men are descended from the first men born and live longer and are sturdier than other men.

race.name: Gnomes
race.description: Gnomes are a highly reclusive folk who spend a lifetime collecting enchantments of various types. They have a keen sense of intellect and will sometimes spend years solving some archaic puzzle or mystery. Both the males and females in Gnomish society have similar builds.

race.name: Elves, High
race.description: High elves are tall and graceful, living in cities with a high culture, they tend to disdain other races.

race.name: Kobolds
race.description: Kobolds

race.name: Troglodytes
race.description: Troglodytes

race.name: Orcs, Common
race.description: Orcs, Scrug

race.name: Half-elves
race.description: Half-elves are a rare breed with one parent human and the other elvish.

race.name: Men, Common
race.description: Common men live throughout the continents in many environments.
